movie.title: Miss Sloane
movie.overview: An ambitious lobbyist faces off against the powerful gun lobby in an attempt to pass gun control legislation.

facts: Did you know that 'Miss Sloane' was directed by John Madden? He's the talent behind the camera for this gripping political thriller!
The sharp, intricate screenplay for 'Miss Sloane' was penned by Jonathan Perera. It's always fascinating to know the mind behind such a powerful story!

Talk about a star-studded lineup! 'Miss Sloane' features an incredible ensemble cast including Jessica Chastain, Mark Strong, Gugu Mbatha-Raw, Michael Stuhlbarg, Alison Pill, Jake Lacy, John Lithgow, and Sam Waterston.
